subtitles.en: Raël's 1979 follow-up: questions, new revelations, and the atheist religion

descriptions.en: Raël's 1979 third foundational book — a wide-ranging Q&A addressing the questions most often raised after the first two messages, a set of *new revelations* permitted after a three-year waiting period, the deliberate framing of Raëlism as an *atheist religion* centered on the *Elohim*, and a closing collection of commentaries and testimonials by named Raëlians.
